What comes in the box

Your buttonshave been to places

When your Cloud & Stone arrives, there are cards inside — one for each button. Each card is about that specific stone. Where it was. When. What it felt like to pick it up.

These are stones that were on a beach before they were buttons. Stones that spent years under forest leaf-fall before they were yours. The cards remember that. They're yours to keep.

"Your buttons have been to places. The cards tell you where."

Send Your Stone

Your stone. Your story.

Found something extraordinary?

If you've ever picked up a stone and kept it — from a beach you'll never go back to, a path on a trip that changed something, your grandmother's garden — send it to us.

We'll drill it, set it on a Cloud & Stone cardigan, and write the card ourselves, in your words. Your stone becomes a button. Your story goes to whoever wears it. They'll carry a piece of somewhere that was yours.

"Every stone was somewhere before it was a button. Yours can be too."

Send Your Stone →
01

Find it

Pick up a stone that means something to you. It doesn't need to be beautiful — it needs to have been somewhere.

Beach, forest, riverbed, garden, mountain, city pavement — anywhere counts.

02

Write us the story

Tell us where you found it, when, what was happening. Two sentences or twenty — whatever feels right.

This becomes the card that goes with the button.

03

Send it

We give you our address. Your stone comes to us in Turkey. We check it's suitable for drilling — most are.

04

It becomes a button

We set it on the next Cloud & Stone we make. The card carries your story. That piece is yours to keep or give — or it goes to whoever orders next.

You choose whether your name is on the card.

The Making

The Origin

Knitted in Turkey, finished by the world

The Cloud & Stone begins as a cone of kid mohair and silk — a blend so light it barely registers. A single knitter works the lace pattern over many days. The pattern is a traditional Turkish diamond-and-eyelet structure, passed between knitters the way recipes travel between kitchens.

When the knitting is done, the piece is not finished. It waits for its stones. We gather them from everywhere — beaches where the tide has been smoothing them for decades, forest paths where iron from the soil has left its mark, riverbeds, highland passes, coastal cliffs. Each stone is held, turned, considered. Most are left where they were found. A few come with us. Those become buttons. And then cards.

Every piece we make is numbered. Every stone set is documented — where it was gathered, what landscape it came from. Your cardigan carries a small piece of a real place.

Details & Care

  • Your Cloud & Stone cardigan, knitted in Turkey
  • A story card for every button — where it was found, what it looked like, why it was chosen
  • Piece number card — your cardigan is numbered in the series
  • Care instructions on uncoated stock
  • 70% Kid Mohair, 30% Silk — Italian-spun yarn
  • Traditional Turkish diamond lace pattern, knitted
  • Buttons: natural stones gathered from beaches, forest floors, riverbeds and mountain paths worldwide
  • Each stone drilled with a single hole — the minimum possible intervention
  • Ribbed collar, cuffs and hem in 2×2 rib
  • XS: Bust 32–34" · Fitted silhouette
  • S: Bust 34–36" · Relaxed fit
  • M: Bust 36–38" · Relaxed / oversized
  • L: Bust 38–40" · Oversized
  • XL: Bust 40–42" · Maximum volume
  • Length: approximately 22" cropped. Custom length on request.
  • Hand wash cold in wool-gentle detergent, or dry clean
  • Lay flat to dry — never hang, never tumble dry
  • Stone buttons are natural objects — handle with care, avoid hard impact
  • Store folded in breathable cotton or linen
  • Light pilling on mohair is natural and softens beautifully with wear

Every piece is made to order. We do not keep inventory. Your order is confirmed within 24 hours and production begins immediately. Typical lead time is 3–4 weeks. Worldwide shipping included. We write your stone cards personally before packing your piece.
